title: Birth in Algiers and the musical Bocage family
summary: Born in Algiers in 1900; father, brothers, sisters and a cousin were musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yes I was born in Algiers Louisiana. January the 14th 1900.
And uh, exactly what part of Algiers? You know the street?
Yeah I think it was on Powder Street. 530 Powder Street if hmm.
Uh huh. Interesting. You mentioned uh, several fellows in your family were musical?
Yes my daddy and uh, two brothers and also two sisters. Uh huh.
Well I had one sister named Boetha and uh, Lillian. And my father was uh, Leopold Vorkaige. And of course my other two brothers is uh, Henry and Boethaige, Henry Clay and uh, Peter Boethaige.
Do you have any cousins that play?
Well I have one cousin in Algiers uh, that's a musician, Wilfred Boethaige and alto sax player.
